Use case: illustration-story. One complete literary-room companion mother artwork, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, horizontal canvas. Keep the exact close room camera and mild perspective of IMAGE 1. Preserve its complete large wood window, autumn lake-town and mountain view, ivory curtains, left wood writing desk and original wooden chair, shelves/books/frames/plants, round side table and its blue-white porcelain lamp/cup/books/flowers, long wood window bench with linen cushion, blue-gray plaid pillows and knit throw at right, wood floor, woven rug and softly blurred foreground plant. The view is a fictional illustrated literary room, not a claimed actual location. One person only. No new desk, extra chair, moved window, zoom, crop, room redesign, second person or extra off-camera hands. Existing lamp and cup stay on their original table.

文学瞬间：读到一点不愿立刻承认的自己。
心理：书里一句爱面子的心事让她停住。她想笑过去，又想把这个读法讲给对方听。 轻快与被戳中的迟疑只错开一点，让书真正进入她的神情。 她在书里认出那点爱面子，翻页前短短停住。
目光：先停在页内，再抬眼看对方是否也读到那层意思。 页内到对方，再回页内。
相处：邀请交换读法，保留被对方读出另一层的可能。 把结论留一半，等对方笑她或另读。
表情：笑意很浅，眼里有疑问与一点不好意思。 嘴角将起未起，眼神略带自我调侃。
光线：杏金光擦过书口和粉色发丝，纸页白度自然。

Character: Anon Chihaya / 千早愛音, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Keep the youthful identifiable anime face and ordinary student proportions of her approved input: long clear PINK hair, natural side-swept bangs, bright BLUE-GRAY eyes, fine lively youthful face. Both eyes and bangs must remain clearly drawn and visible. Faithful Haneoka clothes: pale lavender-gray school blazer, white piping and two small gold buttons, white collared shirt, dark green necktie, dark green/gold plaid skirt, dark knee socks, BLACK loafers. Preserve her own colors under the light. No borrowed face/uniform, mature model styling or chibi proportions. Modest fully clothed school-day companionship.

New READING pose and real support: sit on the actual right-hand portion of the window bench in front of the plaid pillows. Her pelvis and thighs have weight on the linen cushion. An open modest cloth-spine book rests on her knees, supported clearly by both hands; it stays below her face. At this instant she has just lifted her eyes slightly from the page toward the off-camera companion, while one hand still lightly keeps her place. The small hesitation belongs to something she recognized about herself, not a generic invitation to pose. Shoulders easy, balanced seated spine, head close to upright. Each knee/lower leg is separately legible in a simple comfortable arrangement; two complete black shoes rest naturally on the floor, with a small ordinary stagger if needed. Do not cross one knee over the other while showing two parallel flat feet. Cushion, book weight, hands, wrists and shoes all have real support.

Scale, anatomy and finish: keep the newly approved close-camera human scale of this same character. A bench pose can have hair top around y=110 and shoes around y=850–900, with the precise shoe depth following the real seat position; the desk pose must follow its real chair and floor perspective rather than mechanically copy bench coordinates. Never enlarge the head, lean the face toward the lens, elongate shins or shrink furniture to force a number. Keep the entire hair, hands, knees, ankles and BOTH complete shoes in frame. Basic joints and the two legs must read continuously and independently; hands have coherent fingers and wrists, no fused limbs, no furniture penetration. Natural soft local contact shadows and honest occlusion. Subtle almond-gold clear-day window light, distinct local hair/skin/clothing colors, clear gentle facial shadow planes, natural white paper and ivory fabric. Refined anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the detailed literary room, no sticker edge, gray/gold overlay or new colored spotlight. Book/paper marks are faint abstract texture only: no readable quotes, names, dates, calendar, completed task or schedule. No UI, sleep icons, speech, caption, logo, watermark, border, collage or artificial fog.
